accounts.prompt: File routine mail I can read later. Deliver personal messages, requests that need my reply, security alerts, login codes and outstanding tasks. Ask completely new senders to verify unsolicited cold pitches.

labels.name: Clefmail/Receipts
labels.description: Paid receipts, completed transactions, refund confirmations and purchase records that need no action.

labels.name: Clefmail/Newsletters
labels.description: Editorial newsletters, articles, digests, and subscribed reading material.

labels.name: Clefmail/Notifications
labels.description: Routine account and service updates, delivery confirmations and resolved support cases that need no attention.

labels.name: Clefmail/Promotions
labels.description: Mass marketing, product announcements, retail offers and event advertising suitable for filing.
